run_oneshot_quantize: run oneshot to apply AWQ W4AFP8 quantization to a Llama model using calibration data
create_awq_modifier: create an AWQModifier recipe with W4AFP8 scheme, Linear targets, and duo scaling enabled
preprocess_dataset: preprocess a HuggingFace dataset by applying a chat template via the tokenizer
test_quantized_model: test a quantized model by generating text from a prompt and decoding the output
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in pack-quantized format for vLLM compatibility
